current_interpretation: The literature contains each component separately—empirical hysteresis, real division of labour, reversible task allocation, and generalist-specialist performance contrasts—but the strict within-unit shared/generalist versus differentiated/specialized architecture hysteresis object with matched forward/reverse thresholds and uncertainty has not been recovered in the screened public literature.
reopen_search_when: a new source explicitly reports forward and reverse thresholds for the same multifunctional architecture under one graded control axis
a public dataset permits recovery of both thresholds with uncertainty without redefining the architecture state post hoc
a targeted experiment is available that prospectively manipulates one architecture-control axis in both directions
prohibited_inference: do not infer universal absence of empirical architecture hysteresis from this finite search
do not promote model hysteresis, generic memory, population coexistence, or evolutionary reversal as a within-unit architecture receipt
